raw_response:
I been growing cotton here in Quzhou for 30 years, so I mostly do what worked last year and adjust a bit. My land is 13.1 mu all in cotton — no grain rotation because cotton pays better for us and the soil here is alright for it.

For seed, I buy 抗虫棉 (Bt hybrid cotton) from the dealer in town. Everyone around me uses it — no point planting old varieties when the bollworm will eat them. One bag covers about 2 mu, so I buy 7 bags to be safe.

Tillage — I plough deep in spring before planting, then rotary to break up the clods. Deep plough every year keeps the roots going down and helps with salt.

For fertilizer, I follow what worked: base fertilizer before planting I put compound fertilizer (15-15-15) about 50 kg per mu, that gives me roughly 7-8 kg N, same P and K. Then at squaring (现蕾) I topdress urea about 15 kg per mu, that's another 7 kg N. At flowering/bolling (花铃期) I topdress again, urea 20 kg plus some potassium sulfate 10 kg per mu. Total N about 16 kg/mu, P about 8 kg, K about 13 kg. I would rather put a little extra than lose bolls — fertilizer costs money but an empty field is disaster.

Irrigation — I have well so I water when I need. Usually once before planting to moisten the soil, once at squaring if no rain, twice during flowering and bolling. About 4 times total.

Pesticide — even with Bt cotton, I still spray a lot for aphids (蚜虫), spider mites (红蜘蛛), and plant bugs (盲蝽). Probably 8 sprays through the season. My neighbor Old Wang sprays 10 times but I think 8 is enough if I scout well.

Yield — last year I got about 280 kg seed cotton per mu. If weather holds I expect similar, maybe 290.
